libs.note: BH-6501: the Vercel preview gate inside bin/pre-arm-guards.sh. A gated repo's PR head whose own newest Vercel preview is ERROR answers rc 1 (park); a preview still building answers rc 3 (retry). The state comes from the vercel-deploy-snapshot files; a missing or stale snapshot never holds a merge. Resolved at call time with lib_env_apply pre-arm-preview; tests/pre-arm-preview.bh-6501-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: The fleet.conf projects the preview gate checks, a space list. A value that names no project (for example `off`) turns the gate off fleet-wide. Read as ${PRE_ARM_PREVIEW_PROJECTS-project-3}.
Head branch globs the preview gate never holds, a space list. Rollback PRs (project-3 #486/#499/#501) had a FAILED preview and must still land; revert-* is GitHub's revert branch name.
A head preview still BUILDING, QUEUED or INITIALIZING and younger than this answers rc 3 (retry next tick). Older, it does not hold the merge. 0 = never wait.
A snapshot whose generated_at is older than this is blind: the gate logs one line and does not hold the merge. The snapshot lane runs every 4 minutes, so 30 = 7 missed runs.
